walkthroughs.body_html: An element has one type of atom; a compound has 2+ elements bonded; a mixture is not bonded.

A pure substance has a sharp mp.

Impurities lower mp and widen the range.

mcqs.q: Best method to separate ink colours:
What distinguishes structural isomers from stereoisomers?
options: Stereoisomers are just structural isomers drawn from a different angle.
Stereoisomers have different numbers of atoms but the same molecular formula.
Structural isomers have different atom connectivity; stereoisomers have the same connectivity but different spatial arrangement.

mcqs.q: How is a dynamic equilibrium different from a static one?
options: Dynamic and static equilibria are the same thing because both show constant macroscopic properties.
A dynamic equilibrium means the system is still changing visibly.
In a dynamic equilibrium, forward and reverse reactions continue at equal rates; in a static equilibrium, nothing is happening at the particle level.
